0.0.n: This question word asks about location; the thing being sought is left unstated.

0.1.n: The plain, casual form of です gives this question a direct tone.

1.0.n: Pairs with に to show that people do the action as a group.

1.1.n: Turns いっしょ into a phrase describing how the searching will be done.

1.2.n: 探そう is the invitation form of 探す, used here to suggest searching with someone.

0.tip: Japanese often leaves out the subject when context makes it clear.

1.tip: The ending ～そう in 探そう makes a casual invitation; the polite version is 探しましょう.
